meta.camera_note: Pixel 9 Pro XL 1080p video, portrait 1080x1920. Photo calibration f=2935 px at 4080 px width scales to 1381 px at 1920 px; stabilisation crops about 1.10-1.20x, so f_video was taken as 1660 px (range 1520-1660), principal point at the image centre. Camera position was resected from the inside corner and the two window casings (plan positions), heights from the stool line; an outlet plate measured 4.1 in tall against 4.5 nominal, so lengths carry about +/-8%.
